ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is a large equilateral triangular grid whose side length is divided into 6 small step lengths, so there are altogether 36 small equilateral triangles with area 1 cm^2. The three vertices of the shaded triangle are all on grid points: A is on the left slanted side, 1 small step length upward from the lower-left corner; B is on the bottom side, at the 4th small step length counted along the bottom side from the lower-left corner; C is on the right slanted side, located on the horizontal grid line of the 3rd layer upward from the bottom side. Then reason: Take oblique coordinates according to the specified method: with the lower-left corner as the origin, the direction along the bottom side as one unit, and the direction along the left slanted side as one unit. Thus A=(0,1), B=(4,0), C=(3,3). The basic parallelogram spanned by the two coordinate unit vectors is composed of two small equilateral triangles, so its area is 2 cm^2. Therefore in this kind of oblique coordinates, the triangle area equals the numerical value of the absolute value of the determinant of the corresponding two side vectors, with unit cm^2. Calculation: B-A=(4,-1), C-A=(3,2). The determinant det(B-A,C-A)=det((4,-1),(3,2))=4·2-(-1)·3=8+3=11. So the area of triangle ABC is 11 cm^2.

raw_record.question_text: The big equilateral triangle consists of 36 small equilateral triangles, each of area $1\mathrm{~cm}^2$. Determine the area of $ABC$.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the large equilateral triangle is a triangular lattice with 6 small-triangle side steps; the marked vertices lie on lattice points, with A at the first lattice point above the lower-left corner on the left side, B at the fourth lattice point from the lower-left corner along the base, and C on the right side at the third horizontal level above the base. Put oblique coordinates on the triangular lattice: origin at the lower-left vertex, one unit along the base, one unit along the left side. Then A=(0,1), B=(4,0), C=(3,3). Use the fact that one fundamental lattice parallelogram contains two small triangles, so the area of a triangle with coordinate edge vectors has area equal to the absolute determinant in cm^2. Compute det(B-A, C-A)=det((4,-1),(3,2))=11, giving area 11 cm^2.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中是一个边长被分成 6 个小步长的大等边三角形网格，因此共有 36 个面积为 1 cm^2 的小等边三角形。阴影三角形的三个顶点都在格点上：A 在左边斜边上，离左下角向上 1 个小步长；B 在底边上，从左下角沿底边数第 4 个小步长处；C 在右边斜边上，位于从底边向上第 3 层的水平格线上。

再推理：按指定方法取斜坐标：以左下角为原点，沿底边方向为一个单位，沿左边斜边方向为一个单位。于是 A=(0,1)，B=(4,0)，C=(3,3)。

两个坐标单位向量张成的基本平行四边形由两个小等边三角形组成，所以其面积为 2 cm^2。因此在这种斜坐标中，三角形面积等于对应两个边向量行列式绝对值的数值，单位为 cm^2。

计算：B-A=(4,-1)，C-A=(3,2)。
行列式 det(B-A,C-A)=det((4,-1),(3,2))=4·2-(-1)·3=8+3=11。

所以三角形 ABC 的面积为 11 cm^2。

method.method_draft: First describe the image: ABC is a triangle whose vertices are lattice points of the triangular grid; visually, its sides pass through no other lattice vertices besides A, B, and C, and there are 5 lattice intersection points strictly inside the shaded triangle. With I=5 interior lattice points and L=3 boundary lattice points, the area is 2(I+L/2-1)=2(5+3/2-1)=11 cm^2.
